resources.Original: A entrada de corrida do registrador foi capturada; a admissão ao treino inicial aguarda verificação.
resources.Translated: 记录器已捕获比赛输入;初始训练的准入等待确认。

resources.Original: Objetivo da licença: produzir filhotes G9
resources.Translated: 许可证目标：生育 G9 幼崽

resources.Key: Buy a G1 {0} registration form to raise a missing owned parent.
resources.Original: Compre uma ficha de registro G1 {0} para criar um progenitor próprio ausente.
resources.Translated: 购买 G1 {0}注册表，创建一个缺失的自身父项。

resources.Original: O nível de aposentadoria {0} está fora de 40-50.
resources.Translated: 退休金水平{0}不在 40-50 之间。

resources.Key: Another Choke-abo automation owns the feed/vendor services.
resources.Original: Outra automação do Choke-abo controla os serviços de alimentação/vendedor.
resources.Translated: 另一个 Choke-ab 自动化控制喂食/供应商服务。

resources.Key: Feed purchase would cross the configured currency reserve.
resources.Original: A compra de ração usaria a reserva de moeda configurada.
resources.Translated: 配给购买将使用已配置的货币储备。

resources.Original: Aposentando o chocobo de corrida intermediário
resources.Translated: 正在退役的中长跑选手 Chocobo

resources.Key: This target cycle is owned by VERMAXION; use its Target Pedigree controls.
resources.Original: Este ciclo do alvo é controlado pelo VERMAXION; use seus controles de Pedigree alvo.
resources.Translated: 这个目标循环由 VERMAXION 控制;使用您的目标 Pedigree 控制。

resources.Key: The registered G{0} racer is below the retained G{1} pedigree; lower-generation racing is stopped.
resources.Original: O chocobo de corrida G{0} registrado está abaixo do pedigree G{1} mantido; as corridas de gerações inferiores estão interrompidas.
resources.Translated: 注册的 G{0}赛车巧克力低于保留的 G{1}血统;较低世代的赛车已经停止。
开始/停止覆盖范围选择器

resources.Key: Offspring production requires G9 breeding stock; lower-generation racing is stopped.
resources.Original: A produção de filhotes requer plantel G9; as corridas de gerações inferiores estão interrompidas.
resources.Translated: 幼崽的生产需要 G9 植株;下一代的竞争已经中断。

resources.Key: The feed batch is not fully present in inventory; reconcile its pending purchases before another vendor visit.
resources.Original: O lote de ração não está totalmente no inventário; concilie suas compras pendentes antes de outra visita ao vendedor.
resources.Translated: 配给批次并未完全列入库存;在再次拜访卖家之前，请妥善处理您未完成的采购。

resources.Key: Cover the exact G{0} pair to produce the missing G{1} sex while the useful racer continues racing.
resources.Original: Cubra o par G{0} exato para produzir o sexo G{1} ausente enquanto o chocobo útil continua correndo.
resources.Translated: 覆盖正确的 G{0}对，以产生缺失的 G{1}性别，同时有用的巧克力棒继续运行。

resources.Key: Cover the retained G{0} parent and matching opposite-sex permit to produce G{1}.
resources.Original: Cubra o progenitor G{0} mantido com uma licença correspondente do sexo oposto para produzir G{1}.
resources.Translated: 用相应的异性许可证覆盖保留的亲代 G{0}，以产生 G{1}。

resources.Key: Use Refresh Chocobo Data or /chokeabo refresh to load racing chocobo stats.
resources.Original: Use Atualizar dados do chocobo ou /chokeabo refresh para carregar os atributos do chocobo de corrida.
resources.Translated: 使用 “刷新 Chocobo 数据” 或 “/chokeabo 刷新” 来加载赛车 Chocobo 属性。

resources.Key: An unowned Proof of Covering is present; its exact start time cannot be inferred safely.
resources.Original: Há um Proof of Covering sem proprietário; não é possível deduzir seu horário exato de início com segurança.
resources.Translated: 存在一个无所有者的覆盖证明;无法安全地推断出它的准确起始时间。

resources.Key: Training confirmation window did not appear after Commence.
resources.Original: A janela de confirmação do treino não apareceu após Commence.
resources.Translated: 训练确认窗口在开始后未显示。

resources.Original: Os dados do chocobo de corrida registrado estão indisponíveis.
resources.Translated: 注册比赛巧克力的数据不可用。

resources.Key: The required breeding supply was not found in the verified native shop.
resources.Original: O suprimento de reprodução necessário não foi encontrado na loja nativa verificada.
resources.Translated: 所需的繁殖用品在已核实的原产地商店中未找到。

resources.Key: Breeding service interaction captured; its native selection must be verified before dispatch.
resources.Original: Interação com o serviço de reprodução capturada; verifique sua seleção nativa antes de enviar.
resources.Translated: 与捕获的播放服务交互;发送前请检查您的原生选择。

resources.Key: Cover matching G9 stock with its retained opposite-sex G9 parent.
resources.Original: Cubra o plantel G9 compatível com seu progenitor G9 mantido do sexo oposto.
resources.Translated: 覆盖与其保留的异性祖先 G9 相匹配的 G9 植株。

resources.Key: Refresh requested; opening Gold Saucer window...
resources.Original: Atualização solicitada; abrindo janela do Gold Saucer...
resources.Translated: 请求更新;打开 Gold Saucer 窗口......

resources.Original: G{0} {1}: nível de corrida {2}/40 antes da aposentadoria.

resources.Key: Cover the exact G{0} pair to advance toward G{1}.
resources.Original: Cubra o par G{0} exato para avançar até G{1}.
resources.Translated: 覆盖正确的 G{0}对以前进到 G{1}。

resources.Key: No logged-in Content ID is available.
resources.Original: Nenhum Content ID de personagem conectado está disponível.
resources.Translated: 没有已连接角色的内容 ID 可用。
内容 ID 不同：请求 {0}，当前 {1}。

resources.Key: Register the exact G{0} fledgling in {1} slot {2}.
resources.Original: Registre o filhote G{0} exato no espaço {2} de {1}.
resources.Translated: 在{1}的{2}空格中记录准确的子 G{0}。

resources.Original: Atualização dos atributos do chocobo de corrida cancelada.
resources.Translated: 比赛巧克力属性更新已取消。

resources.Key: Feeding one {0}; awaiting exact item and session evidence.
resources.Original: Usando uma unidade de {0}; aguardando evidências do item e da sessão exatos.
resources.Translated: 使用{0}单位;等待确切的项目和会话证据。

resources.Key: Complete the registrar's initial racing training course.
resources.Original: Conclua o curso inicial de corrida do registrador.
resources.Translated: 完成记录员的初始跑步课程。

resources.Original: Compra de ração do alvo bloqueada: {0}
resources.Translated: 购买已锁定目标的配给:{0}

resources.Key: Track current stats and feed plans.
resources.Original: Acompanhar atributos atuais e planos de alimentação.
resources.Translated: 跟踪当前属性和电源计划。

resources.Key: Raise the matching G9 parent to retirement: racing rank {0}/40. Matching offspring stay unregistered.
resources.Original: Leve o progenitor G9 compatível à aposentadoria: nível de corrida {0}/40. Os filhotes compatíveis ficam sem registro.
resources.Translated: 携带符合退休条件的亲代 G9:奔跑水平{0}/40。符合条件的幼崽将无需注册。

resources.Key: UI fonts failed to load. See the plugin log.
resources.Original: Falha ao carregar fontes da interface. Veja o log do plugin.
resources.Translated: 加载接口字体失败。请参阅插件日志。

resources.Key: No usable G{0} parent remains to produce a G{1} counterpart. Lower-generation covering is stopped.
resources.Original: Não resta progenitor G{0} utilizável para produzir um par G{1}. A cobertura de gerações inferiores está interrompida.
resources.Translated: 已经没有父代 G{0}可以用来产生 G{1}对了。下一代的覆盖已经中断。

resources.Key: Gold Saucer Info ready; waiting before Chocobo tab callback.
resources.Original: Informações do Gold Saucer prontas; aguardando antes do callback da aba Chocobo.
resources.Translated: Gold Saucer 信息准备就绪;等待 Chocobo 选项卡回调。

resources.Key: A Proof of Covering is present.
Native racing unlock verified; reassessing feeding and racing.
resources.Original: Desbloqueio nativo das corridas verificado; reavaliando alimentação e corridas.
resources.Translated: 原生解锁已验证的比赛;重新评估饲料和比赛。

resources.Original: Abrindo menu de contexto do inventário...

resources.Key: XA Slave log tools could not be opened.
resources.Original: Не удалось открыть инструменты журналов XA Slave.
resources.Translated: 无法打开 XA Slave 日志工具。

resources.Key: The registered G9 racer does not have a confirmed requested trait. Retain it and select suitable breeding stock.
resources.Original: У гонщика G9 нет подтверждённого нужного признака. Сохраните его и выберите подходящий запас.
resources.Translated: G9 赛车手没有经过验证的特征。请保留它并选择合适的储备。

resources.Key: Complete Like Sire Like Fledgling before retiring this racer.
resources.Original: Пройдите Like Sire Like Fledgling перед выводом гонщика.
resources.Translated: 在输出赛车手之前，请执行 Like Sire Like Fledling。

resources.Key: Stock cleanup is active; stop it before starting breeding.
resources.Original: Очистка запасов активна; остановите её перед началом разведения.
resources.Translated: 库存清理处于活跃状态;在开始繁殖之前停止。

resources.Key: Paused by VERMAXION at a safe boundary.
resources.Translated: VERMAXION 在安全边界被暂停。

resources.Key: The Tack & Feed Trader is unavailable for interaction.
resources.Original: Tack & Feed Trader недоступен для взаимодействия.
resources.Translated: Tack & Feed Trader 无法进行交互。

resources.Key: Purchased feed could not be resolved to an exact inventory slot.
resources.Original: Купленный корм нельзя привязать к точному слоту инвентаря.
resources.Translated: 购买的饲料不能固定在物品的精确位置。

resources.Key: Offspring sex is random. Two coverings do not guarantee a male and a female.
resources.Original: Пол потомства случаен. Два скрещивания не гарантируют самца и самку.
resources.Translated: 后代的性别是随机的。两次杂交并不能保证雌雄同体。

resources.Key: The acceptable colours are unavailable in current game data.
resources.Original: Допустимые цвета отсутствуют в текущих данных.
resources.Translated: 当前数据中没有可接受的颜色。

resources.Key: The required covering fee would cross the gil reserve. Explicit Resume is required.
resources.Original: Сбор за скрещивание нарушит резерв гил. Нужно явное возобновление.
resources.Translated: 杂交收费将破坏胶水储备。需要明确更新。

resources.Key: Log into a character before starting breeding automation.
resources.Translated: 在自动离婚前输入角色。

resources.Key: Missing a usable opposite-sex G9 parent. Owned mode requires suitable G9 stock or an explicit switch to NPC permits.
resources.Original: Нет пригодного родителя G9 другого пола. Нужен запас G9 или явный переход на разрешения NPC.
resources.Translated: 没有合格的异性 G9 父母。需要 G9 储备或明确过渡到 NPC 许可。

resources.Key: Timed out moving near Race Chocobo Trainer.
resources.Original: Истекло время подхода к Race Chocobo Trainer.
resources.Translated: 与 Race Chocobo Trainer 接触的时间已经结束。

resources.Key: The current racer exceeds the selected target pedigree; retain it.
resources.Original: Текущий гонщик выше целевой родословной; сохраните его.
resources.Translated: 当前车手高于目标血统;保留它。

resources.Key: The selected covering stock is captured; native selected-parent evidence and the fee require verification before Commence.
resources.Original: Выбранный запас записан; проверьте нативные данные родителей и сбор перед началом.
resources.Translated: 选择的储备已记录;开始前请检查父母的原始数据和收集情况。
无论如何都要导出完整日志

resources.Key: Pause Content ID does not match the current character.
resources.Original: Content ID паузы не совпадает с текущим персонажем.
resources.Translated: 暂停的 Content ID 与当前角色不匹配。

resources.Key: No usable retired G9 parent has a confirmed requested trait. Retain offspring and replenish suitable G9 stock.
resources.Original: Нет пригодного выведенного родителя G9 с нужным признаком. Сохраните потомство и пополните запас G9.
resources.Translated: 没有符合要求的 G9 育种亲本。保存后代并补充 G9 库存。

resources.Key: No breeding forms or covering proof in inventory.
resources.Original: В инвентаре нет племенных формуляров или свидетельства скрещивания.
resources.Translated: 清单中没有部落公式或杂交证据。

resources.Key: Feed the target racer before declaring it ready.
resources.Original: Накормите целевого гонщика перед объявлением готовности.
resources.Translated: 在宣布准备就绪之前，为目标车手提供食物。

resources.Key: Reload found an unverified feed-purchase intent; it will not be replayed.
resources.Original: После перезагрузки найдена непроверенная покупка; повторяться не будет.
resources.Translated: 重新下载后，发现未经验证的购买;此操作不会再次发生。

resources.Key: Target inputs changed while an immediate feed action was awaiting evidence.
resources.Original: Цель изменилась, пока немедленное кормление ожидало подтверждения.
resources.Translated: 目标已经改变，但立即喂食仍在等待确认。

resources.Key: Covering is eligible; collection requires a verified native UI mapping.
resources.Original: Скрещивание готово; получение требует проверенного нативного сопоставления.
resources.Translated: 杂交准备就绪;接收需要经过验证的原生匹配。
前往 Tack & Feed Trader 的流量......

resources.Key: Covering Commence was dispatched; its exact confirmation or proof result must be reconciled before another covering.
resources.Original: Начало скрещивания отправлено; сверьте точное подтверждение или свидетельство перед следующим.
resources.Translated: 杂交开始已发送;请在下次之前核实准确的确认或证明。

resources.Key: The covering confirmation would cross the gil reserve. Explicit Resume is required.
resources.Original: Подтверждение нарушит резерв гил. Требуется явное возобновление.
resources.Translated: 确认将影响燃料储备。需要明确更新。

resources.Key: Could not reach the required breeding service for native UI inspection.
resources.Original: Не удалось добраться до нужного сервиса для нативной проверки.
resources.Translated: 无法访问所需的服务进行本地验证。

resources.Key: Retirement confirmation sent; awaiting the retired form and cleared current racer. Any further native prompt is captured before another action.
resources.Original: Подтверждение вывода отправлено; ожидание формы и пустого гонщика. Дальнейшие окна записываются перед действием.
resources.Translated: 输出确认已发送;等待表格和空赛车手。后续窗口将在行动前记录。

resources.Key: Finish the existing covering with its saved goal before changing the production target.
resources.Original: Завершите скрещивание с сохранённой целью перед сменой цели производства.
resources.Translated: 在改变生产目标之前，完成与保留目标的杂交。
与 NPC 的对话许可

resources.Key: A required-supply purchase is unverified after reload; its matching pending confirmation or inventory result is required before another purchase.
resources.Original: Покупка непроверена после перезагрузки; нужны соответствующее подтверждение или инвентарь до следующей.
resources.Translated: 重新下载后，购买未经验证;需要相应的确认或库存，直到下次。

resources.Key: Could not path near Race Chocobo Trainer. Move closer or check vnavmesh.
resources.Original: Нет пути к Race Chocobo Trainer. Подойдите ближе или проверьте vnavmesh.
resources.Translated: 无法访问 Race Chocobo Trainer。请靠近或查看 vnavmesh。

resources.Key: vnavmesh is unavailable or not ready for target feeding.
resources.Original: vnavmesh недоступен или не готов к целевому кормлению.
resources.Translated: vnavmesh 不可用或尚未准备好进行目标喂养。

resources.Key: Covering is eligible; adoption is awaiting exact capture evidence.
resources.Original: Скрещивание готово; получение ждёт точных записанных данных.
resources.Translated: 交叉已准备就绪;接收正在等待准确记录的数据。

resources.Key: Context menu disappeared before Feed could be selected.
resources.Original: Контекстное меню исчезло до выбора кормления.
resources.Translated: 在选择喂食之前，关联菜单会消失。

resources.Key: Reconcile the existing Proof of Covering before another covering.
resources.Original: Сверьте текущее свидетельство перед новым скрещиванием.
resources.Translated: 在进行新的杂交之前，请检查当前证据。

resources.Key: Current racer data has not been loaded.
resources.Translated: 当前车手的数据未下载。

resources.Key: No free main-inventory slot is available for target feed.
resources.Original: Нет свободного места в основном инвентаре для целевого корма.
resources.Translated: 主要库存中没有多余空间放置目标饲料。

resources.Key: Timed out waiting to arrive in Chocobo Square.
resources.Original: Истекло время ожидания прибытия в Chocobo Square.
resources.Translated: 到达 Chocobo 广场的等待时间已经结束。

resources.Key: Required Lifestream/vnavmesh vendor interaction is unavailable.
resources.Original: Нужное взаимодействие с торговцем Lifestream/vnavmesh недоступно.
resources.Translated: 无法与 Lifestream/vnavmesh 商家进行必要的互动。

resources.Key: Feed selection changed after purchase; exact purchase evidence cannot be reconciled.
resources.Original: Корм изменён после покупки; точные данные покупки нельзя сверить.
resources.Translated: 购买后，游戏规则已更改;无法核实购买的准确数据。

resources.Key: Saved collection evidence is invalid; no collection will be replayed.
resources.Original: Сохранённые данные получения недействительны; повтора не будет.
resources.Translated: 保存的接收数据无效;不会重复。
等待赛车乔科博的数据......

resources.Key: The completed feed batch does not contain the current training selection.
resources.Original: В завершённой партии корма нет текущего выбора тренировки.
resources.Translated: 在已完成的饲料批次中，没有当前的训练选择。
打开 XA Slave 日志工具

resources.Key: Log into a character to see chocobo progression.
resources.Original: Войдите персонажем, чтобы увидеть прогресс чокобо.
resources.Translated: 以角色身份登录，查看 Chokobo 的进展。

resources.Key: Retirement menu selected; the resulting native window is captured before confirming retirement.
resources.Original: Меню вывода выбрано; полученное окно записывается до подтверждения.
resources.Translated: 输出菜单已选中;生成的窗口将被记录，直到确认。

resources.Key: The selected target feed item could not be resolved.
resources.Original: Не удалось определить выбранный целевой корм.
resources.Translated: 未能确定选定的目标饲料。

resources.Key: Could not open Race Chocobo Trainer. Move closer and try again.
resources.Original: Не удалось открыть Race Chocobo Trainer. Подойдите ближе и повторите.
resources.Translated: 无法打开 Race Chocobo Trainer。靠近再试一次。

resources.Key: Current currency is below the planned purchase total. Adjust the plan or stock up before the buy loop is enabled.
resources.Original: Средств меньше суммы покупок. Измените план или пополните средства перед запуском покупок.
resources.Translated: 资金少于购买金额。在开始购物之前，请修改计划或补充资金。

resources.Original: Показывать компактный режим в главном окне
resources.Translated: 在主窗口中显示紧凑模式

resources.Key: VERMAXION owns progression settings and the daily racing allowance. Choke-abo carries out feeding and breeding.
resources.Original: VERMAXION управляет настройками прогресса и дневным лимитом гонок. Choke-abo выполняет кормление и разведение.
resources.Translated: VERMAXION 负责控制进度设置和当天的比赛限制。Choke-abo 负责喂食和繁育。

resources.Key: Registration confirmation was sent but matching form consumption and current racer evidence are unavailable.
resources.Original: Подтверждение регистрации отправлено, но нет данных расхода формы и текущего гонщика.
resources.Translated: 注册确认已发送，但没有表格消耗和当前车手的数据。
已启用的 DTR 符号

resources.Key: Opens XA Slave's Utility > XA Mods panel, which contains Dalamud Log Cleaner.
resources.Original: Открывает панель Utility > XA Mods в XA Slave, содержащую Dalamud Log Cleaner.
resources.Translated: 打开包含 Daramud Log Cleaner 的 XA Slave 中的 “实用工具”>“XA Mods” 面板。
计划的剩余部分到达了零

resources.Key: Choose the number of training sessions and feed grade for each stat.
resources.Original: Выберите число тренировок и сорт корма для каждой характеристики.
resources.Translated: 为每项功能选择训练次数和饲料类型。

resources.Key: Loading current racer data before selecting a breeding action.
resources.Original: Загрузка гонщика перед выбором действия разведения.
resources.Translated: 在选择离合操作之前加载赛车手。

resources.Key: This progression requires V3; older callers cannot remove its spending limits.
resources.Original: Для прогресса нужна V3; старые вызовы не могут убрать лимиты расходов.
resources.Translated: 为了取得进展，需要 V3;旧调用无法取消支出限制。

resources.Key: Selected registration form; the resulting registration window is captured for verification.
resources.Original: Форма выбрана; окно регистрации записывается для проверки.
resources.Translated: 表单已选择;注册窗口将被记录以供验证。

resources.Key: Timed out moving near Tack & Feed Trader.
resources.Original: Истекло время подхода к Tack & Feed Trader.
resources.Translated: 使用 Tack & Feed Trader 的时间已经结束。

resources.Key: Feed for the available training sessions cannot be purchased within the currency reserves.
resources.Original: Нельзя купить корм для доступных тренировок в пределах резервов.
resources.Translated: 无法在储备中购买可用于训练的饲料。

resources.Key: No useful active racer, fledgling, or covering parents are available.
resources.Original: Нет полезного гонщика, птенца или родителей для скрещивания.
resources.Translated: 没有有用的赛车手、幼鸟或父母进行交配。

resources.Key: Gold Saucer Info ready; waiting before Chocobo tab callback...
resources.Original: Gold Saucer готов; ожидание вызова вкладки чокобо...
resources.Translated: Gold Saucer 准备就绪;等待 Chokobo 标签的调用......

resources.Key: Feeding did not produce one exact feed-item decrease and one confirmed-session decrease.
resources.Original: Кормление не уменьшило точно на один корм и одну подтверждённую тренировку.
resources.Translated: 喂食量没有精确减少到一次喂食和一次经过验证的训练。

resources.Key: The required supply does not match the selected breeding mode and supplier.
resources.Original: Припас не соответствует выбранному режиму и поставщику.
resources.Translated: 补给与所选模式和供应商不匹配。

resources.Key: A free main-inventory slot is required for the breeding supply.
resources.Original: Для племенного припаса нужен свободный основной слот.
resources.Translated: 部落储备需要一个空闲的主槽。

resources.Key: Could not open Tack & Feed Trader. Move closer and try again.
resources.Original: Не удалось открыть Tack & Feed Trader. Подойдите ближе и повторите.
resources.Translated: 无法打开 Tack & Feed Trader。靠近并再试一次。

resources.Key: Ready to plan the next action
resources.Translated: 您可以计划下一步行动

resources.Key: Collection occurred, but the exact new offspring and its trait must be reconciled before counting or another covering.
resources.Original: Получение произошло; сверьте точное потомство и признак перед подсчётом или скрещиванием.
resources.Translated: 获得已完成;在计数或杂交之前，请确认准确的后代和特征。

resources.Key: Cannot skip feeding without a current racer snapshot.
resources.Original: Нельзя пропустить кормление без текущего снимка гонщика.
resources.Translated: 不能在没有赛车手当前照片的情况下跳过喂食。

resources.Key: The desired inherited ability is unavailable in current game data.
resources.Original: Желаемая наследуемая способность отсутствует в текущих данных.
resources.Translated: 目前数据中未显示所需的继承能力。

resources.Key: The native Select Chocobo list entry is unavailable or disabled.
resources.Original: Нативный пункт Select Chocobo недоступен или отключён.
resources.Translated: 选择 Chocobo 原生项目不可用或已关闭。

resources.Key: Scroll down to "The Dumpster Fire" channel to discuss issues / suggestions for specific plugins.
resources.Original: Проблемы и предложения по плагинам обсуждаются в канале «The Dumpster Fire».
resources.Translated: 问题和插件建议将在 “The Dumpster Fire” 频道中讨论。

resources.Key: Exact shopping list for the current plan.
resources.Original: Точный список покупок для текущего плана.
resources.Translated: 为当前计划准确列出购物清单。

resources.Key: The observed Chocobo tab is not ready for its native button event.
resources.Original: Вкладка чокобо не готова к нативному событию кнопки.
resources.Translated: Chokobo 选项卡尚未准备好接受按钮的原始事件。

resources.Key: Reserve stable and vendor automation seams.
resources.Original: Подготовить интерфейсы автоматизации стойла и торговца.
resources.Translated: 准备马厩和商贩的自动化界面。

resources.Key: Gold Saucer window did not appear in time.
resources.Original: Окно Gold Saucer не появилось вовремя.
resources.Translated: 金碟窗口没有及时出现。

resources.Key: The observed retirement confirmation button is unavailable.
Initial racing tutorial admitted; VERMAXION owns the race.
resources.Original: Начальное обучение допущено; гонкой управляет VERMAXION.
resources.Translated: 初步培训已完成;赛道由 VERMAXION 负责。

resources.Key: The native gil-shop purchase could not be dispatched safely.
resources.Original: Нельзя безопасно отправить нативную покупку за гил.
resources.Translated: 您无法安全地将本地购买的商品发送给吉尔。

resources.Key: Trainer feed inventory did not open after selecting the trainer menu entry.
resources.Original: Инвентарь корма не открылся после выбора меню тренера.
resources.Translated: 选择教练菜单后，饲料库存未打开。

resources.Key: Collection was requested; proof consumption and one matching fledgling must be reconciled before another request.
resources.Original: Получение запрошено; сверьте расход свидетельства и одного подходящего птенца перед повтором.
resources.Translated: 申请领取;在重复之前，请检查证书和一只合格幼鸟的使用情况。

resources.Key: Load racing chocobo data first so the purchase plan can compare against sessions available.
resources.Original: Сначала загрузите данные гоночного чокобо для сверки плана покупок с доступными тренировками.
resources.Translated: 首先，下载赛车数据以查看购物计划和可用的训练。

resources.Key: Inventory window disappeared before the trainer-feed context menu became visible.
resources.Original: Окно инвентаря исчезло до появления меню кормления.
resources.Translated: 在饲料菜单出现之前，物品栏会消失。

resources.Key: This log has reached Dalamud's 100 MiB limit. Logging may have stopped, so recent activity may be missing and this log may not help troubleshoot your current issue.
resources.Original: Этот журнал достиг лимита Dalamud в 100 МиБ. Запись могла остановиться; последние события могут отсутствовать, и журнал может не помочь в диагностике текущей проблемы.
resources.Translated: 该日志已达到 Daramud 100 MiB 的限制。记录可能会停止;最近的事件可能会缺失，而且日志可能无法帮助诊断当前问题。

resources.Key: Breeding supply is purchased, but the supplier interaction did not release; Resume to reconcile the retained item.
resources.Original: Припасы куплены, но взаимодействие не завершено; возобновите для сверки сохранённого предмета.
resources.Translated: 补给已购买，但互动尚未完成;请恢复以检查保存的物品。

resources.Key: Collection requires the existing eligible covering, its retained-parent pedigree and exactly one Proof of Covering.
resources.Original: Получение требует готового скрещивания, родословной родителей и ровно одного свидетельства.
resources.Translated: 获得证书需要准备好杂交、父母血统以及一份完整的证书。

resources.Key: Could not open '{0}' on Tack & Feed Trader.
resources.Original: Не удалось открыть «{0}» у Tack & Feed Trader.
resources.Translated: 未能在 Tack & Feed Trader 上打开{0}。

resources.Key: Racing chocobo page detected; waiting for RaceChocoboManager data.
resources.Translated: 找到赛车手页面;等待 RaceChocoboManager。

resources.Key: Automation uses the session-capped plan and subtracts feed already on hand before buying.
resources.Original: Автоматика ограничивает план доступными тренировками и вычитает имеющийся корм перед покупкой.
resources.Translated: 自动化会将计划限制在可用的训练项目范围内，并在购买前扣除现有饲料。

resources.Key: Target cycle paused at a safe boundary.
resources.Original: Целевой цикл приостановлен на безопасной границе.
resources.Translated: 目标循环在安全边界处暂停。

resources.Key: No visible inventory window was found while opening the trainer-feed context menu.
resources.Original: Нет видимого окна инвентаря при открытии меню кормления.
resources.Translated: 打开喂食菜单时，没有可见的物品栏窗口。

resources.Key: Covering wait has no valid eligibility evidence.
resources.Original: Ожидание скрещивания без действительного подтверждения готовности.
resources.Translated: 在没有实际确认准备情况下等待交配。

resources.Key: Raise this non-matching G9 offspring as the missing owned counterpart; retain matching outputs.
resources.Original: Вырастите неподходящего потомка G9 как недостающего партнёра; подходящих сохраняйте.
resources.Translated: 培养不合适的 G9 后代作为缺失的伴侣;保留合适的。

resources.Key: Commence window did not appear after selecting Feed.
resources.Original: Окно начала не появилось после кормления.
resources.Translated: 喂食后，窗口开始没有出现。

resources.Key: Discard is permanent. G9 stock, covering proof and selected breeding inputs are protected.
resources.Original: Выбрасывание необратимо. Запасы G9, подтверждение спаривания и выбранные материалы для разведения защищены.
resources.Translated: 弃用不可逆。G9 储备、配对确认和选择的繁殖材料均受到保护。

resources.Key: The active racer's sex is unavailable.
resources.Translated: 活跃赛车手的地板无法触及。

resources.Key: Breeding, character or stock changed; cleanup stopped.
resources.Original: Разведение, персонаж или запасы изменились; очистка остановлена.
resources.Translated: 养殖、角色或库存已更改;清理已停止。

resources.Key: Could not path near Tack & Feed Trader. Move closer or check vnavmesh.
resources.Original: Нет пути к Tack & Feed Trader. Подойдите ближе или проверьте vnavmesh.
resources.Translated: 无法访问 Tack & Feed Trader。请靠近或查看 vnavmesh。

resources.Key: Review the selected stock before discarding.
resources.Translated: 在处理前请检查您选择的库存。

resources.Key: Start a new offspring batch only after the existing action, queue and covering have settled.
resources.Original: Начинайте новую партию только после завершения текущего действия, очереди и скрещивания.
resources.Translated: 只有在当前行动、队列和交叉结束后，才能开始新的游戏。

resources.Key: Could not find Race Chocobo Trainer in Chocobo Square.
resources.Original: Race Chocobo Trainer не найден в Chocobo Square.
resources.Translated: 赛车巧克力教练在巧克力广场未被发现。

resources.Key: The retained covering parent changed before native selection.
resources.Original: Сохранённый родитель изменился до нативного выбора.
resources.Translated: 保存的父母在原始选择之前发生了变化。
合适的后代将保持未注册状态。

resources.Key: The selected registration form changed before opening its context menu.
resources.Original: Выбранная форма изменилась до открытия меню.
resources.Translated: 在打开菜单之前，所选形状已更改。

resources.Key: Current racer pedigree, racing rank, or sex is unavailable.
resources.Original: Родословная, ранг или пол текущего гонщика недоступны.
resources.Translated: 当前车手的血统、等级或性别不可访问。

resources.Key: Retirement requires an intermediate rank40 racer and room for its retained form.
resources.Original: Для вывода нужен промежуточный гонщик ранга40 и место для формы.
resources.Translated: 需要一名 40 级中级赛车手和一个场地才能完成比赛。

resources.Key: Log ZIP ready. Share it manually; remove old exports when you no longer need them.
resources.Original: ZIP журнала готов. Отправьте его вручную и удалите ненужные старые экспорты.
resources.Translated: 杂志 ZIP 已准备就绪。手动发送并删除不需要的旧导出内容。

resources.Key: Feed confirmation would cross the configured currency reserve.
resources.Original: Подтверждение корма нарушит заданный резерв валюты.
resources.Translated: 确认饲料将违反规定的外汇储备。

resources.Key: The verified required-supply shop closed before purchase.
resources.Original: Проверенный магазин припасов закрылся до покупки.
resources.Translated: 经过验证的补给品商店在购买前就已关闭。

resources.Key: Could not find Tack & Feed Trader in Chocobo Square.
resources.Original: Tack & Feed Trader не найден в Chocobo Square.
resources.Translated: 在 Chocobo Square 找不到 Tack & Feed Trader。
适用于 FFXIV 的 Dalamud 插件

resources.Key: Reload found an unverified feeding intent; it will not be replayed.
resources.Original: После перезагрузки найдено непроверенное кормление; повторяться не будет.
resources.Translated: 重新启动后，发现未经验证的喂食;不会再次发生。

resources.Key: Feed purchase completed without an exact item-ID quantity increase.
resources.Original: Покупка завершена без точного прироста количества нужного ID.
resources.Translated: 购买完成，所需 ID 的数量没有精确增加。

resources.Key: Could not start Lifestream travel to Chocobo Square.
resources.Original: Не удалось начать переход Lifestream в Chocobo Square.
resources.Translated: 未能成功启动生命之流到 Chocobo 广场的过渡。

resources.Key: Required-supply shop closed before the purchase result was verified.
resources.Original: Магазин припасов закрылся до проверки покупки.
resources.Translated: 物资商店在购买确认前关闭。
更喜欢透明和可预测的流程。

resources.Key: Use the active racer's remaining training sessions before retirement.
resources.Original: Используйте оставшиеся тренировки гонщика перед выводом.
resources.Translated: 在退出前使用剩余的赛车手训练。

resources.Key: Breeding must be settled and G9 reached.
resources.Original: Действия разведения должны завершиться, а G9 — быть достигнуто.
resources.Translated: 分离行动必须完成，G9 必须实现。

resources.Key: RaceChocoboManager did not load within 30 seconds after selecting the native Chocobo tab.
resources.Original: RaceChocoboManager не загрузился за 30 секунд после выбора вкладки.
resources.Translated: RaceChocoboManager 在选择选项卡后 30 秒内无法加载。

resources.Key: Persisted feeding intent has no item baseline.
resources.Original: У сохранённого намерения кормления нет исходных данных предмета.
resources.Translated: 保存的喂养意图不包含对象的原始数据。

resources.Key: Fall back to Grade 1, then skip

resources.Translated: 赛车手乔科博尚未注册。

resources.Key: Status Content ID does not match the current character.
resources.Original: Content ID состояния не совпадает с текущим персонажем.
resources.Translated: 状态的 Content ID 与当前角色不匹配。

resources.Key: Reconcile the existing covering before producing another offspring.
resources.Original: Сверьте текущее скрещивание перед следующим потомком.
resources.Translated: 请在下一个后代出生前检查当前的杂交情况。

resources.Key: The initial racing tutorial awaits the next daily allowance.
resources.Original: Начальное обучение ждёт следующего дневного допуска.
resources.Translated: 初始培训等待下一个日间许可。

resources.Key: Plan training sessions, use feed already in inventory, and buy the remaining feed in one visit.
resources.Original: Запланируйте тренировки, используйте корм в инвентаре и купите недостающий за один визит.
resources.Translated: 安排训练，使用物品栏中的饲料，一次性购买缺少的饲料。

resources.Key: Breeding UI mappings still require native inspection before automatic selection is available.
resources.Original: Сопоставления интерфейса требуют нативной проверки перед автовыбором.
resources.Translated: 接口匹配需要在自动选择之前进行原生验证。

resources.Key: Counterpart covering requires permit mode and a reached pedigree of G2 or higher.
resources.Original: Для пары нужны режим разрешений и достигнутая родословная G2 или выше.
resources.Translated: 对于配对，需要权限模式和已达到的 G2 或更高血统。

resources.Key: Choose your progression goal, reserves and feeding policy in VERMAXION settings, then Resume to begin.
resources.Original: Выберите цель, резервы и правила кормления в VERMAXION, затем нажмите «Возобновить».
resources.Translated: 在 VERMAXION 中选择目标、储备和喂食规则，然后点击 “更新”。

resources.Key: Persisted feed-purchase intent has no item baseline.
resources.Original: У сохранённого намерения покупки нет исходных данных предмета.
resources.Translated: 已保存的购买意图没有物品的原始数据。

resources.Key: Registrar race entry captured; initial training admission is awaiting verification.
resources.Original: Запись гонки захвачена; начальный допуск ожидает проверки.
resources.Translated: 比赛记录已获取;初始权限正在等待验证。
无需对焦即可自动调暗

resources.Key: Another Choke-abo automation owns the feed/vendor services.
resources.Translated: 另一个 Choke-abo 自动程序控制饲料/交易员。

resources.Key: Feed purchase would cross the configured currency reserve.
resources.Original: Покупка корма нарушит заданный резерв валюты.
resources.Translated: 购买饲料将违反规定的外汇储备。

resources.Key: This target cycle is owned by VERMAXION; use its Target Pedigree controls.
resources.Original: Цикл принадлежит VERMAXION; используйте его управление целевой родословной.
resources.Translated: 循环属于 VERMAXION;使用其目标血统管理。

resources.Key: Offspring production requires G9 breeding stock; lower-generation racing is stopped.
resources.Original: Для производства нужен запас G9; гонки младших поколений остановлены.
resources.Translated: 生产需要 G9 库存;年轻一代的竞争已经停止。

resources.Key: The feed batch is not fully present in inventory; reconcile its pending purchases before another vendor visit.
resources.Original: Партия не полностью в инвентаре; сверьте покупки перед новым визитом к торговцу.
resources.Translated: 这批货不完全在库存中;在下次拜访经销商之前，请核实购买情况。

resources.Translated: G{0}缺乏可用的异性亲本，而且没有上一个血统等级的配偶能够繁衍后代。

resources.Key: Permit objective: produce a missing current-pedigree counterpart
resources.Original: İzin hedefi: mevcut soy derecesinin eksik eşini üretmek
resources.Translated: 许可目标：产生当前血统等级的缺失配对

resources.Key: Loading current racer data before selecting a breeding action.
resources.Original: Çiftleştirme eylemi seçilmeden önce mevcut yarışçı verileri yükleniyor.
resources.Translated: 在选择配对操作之前，会加载现有的赛车手数据。

resources.Key: This progression requires V3; older callers cannot remove its spending limits.
resources.Original: Bu ilerleme V3 gerektirir; eski çağıranlar harcama sınırlarını kaldıramaz.
resources.Translated: 这种进步需要 V3;传统召唤者无法突破支出限制。
缺乏焦点时的不透明度 (%)

resources.Key: Selected registration form; the resulting registration window is captured for verification.
resources.Original: Kayıt formu seçildi; açılan kayıt penceresi doğrulama için yakalanır.
resources.Translated: 选择了注册表单;打开的注册窗口将被捕获以进行验证。

resources.Key: Timed out moving near Tack & Feed Trader.
resources.Original: Tack & Feed Trader yakınına giderken süre doldu.
resources.Translated: 当 Tack & Feed Trader 靠近时，时间到了。

resources.Key: Feed for the available training sessions cannot be purchased within the currency reserves.
resources.Original: Kullanılabilir eğitim seansları için yem, para rezervleri korunarak satın alınamıyor.
resources.Translated: 可用培训课程的饲料无法在保留现金储备的情况下购买。

resources.Key: No useful active racer, fledgling, or covering parents are available.
resources.Original: Yararlı aktif yarışçı, yavru veya çiftleştirme ebeveyni yok.
resources.Translated: 没有有用的活跃竞争者、幼崽或交配双亲。

resources.Key: G{0} has already been reached; the target cannot move backwards.
resources.Original: G{0} zaten elde edildi; hedef geriye gidemez.
resources.Translated: G{0}已经达成;目标无法回头。

resources.Key: Gold Saucer Info ready; waiting before Chocobo tab callback...
resources.Original: Gold Saucer Info hazır; Chocobo sekmesi geri çağrısından önce bekleniyor...
resources.Translated: Gold Saucer 信息已准备就绪;Chocobo 选项卡预计将在回拨前收到。

resources.Key: Feeding did not produce one exact feed-item decrease and one confirmed-session decrease.
resources.Original: Besleme, tam olarak bir yem öğesi ve bir onaylanmış seans azalması sağlamadı.
resources.Translated: 喂食未能完全提供诱饵元素，也未能确认减少治疗时间。

resources.Key: The required supply does not match the selected breeding mode and supplier.
resources.Original: Gereken malzeme seçili çiftleştirme modu ve tedarikçiyle uyuşmuyor.
resources.Translated: 所需材料与所选配对模式和供应商不匹配。

resources.Key: A free main-inventory slot is required for the breeding supply.
resources.Original: Damızlık malzemesi için ana envanterde boş yer gerekir.
resources.Translated: 繁育材料需要在主库存中留有空间。

resources.Key: Could not open Tack & Feed Trader. Move closer and try again.
resources.Original: Tack & Feed Trader açılamadı. Yaklaşın ve yeniden deneyin.
resources.Translated: Tap & Feed Trader 无法打开。靠近并再试一次。

resources.Key: Ready to plan the next action
resources.Translated: 准备好规划下一步行动

resources.Key: Collection occurred, but the exact new offspring and its trait must be reconciled before counting or another covering.
resources.Original: Teslim alma gerçekleşti ancak sayım veya yeni çiftleştirme öncesinde tam yeni yavru ve özelliği uzlaştırılmalı.
resources.Translated: 交接已经完成，但在计数或进行新的交配之前，必须对全新的幼崽及其特性进行协调。

resources.Key: Cannot skip feeding without a current racer snapshot.
resources.Original: Mevcut yarışçı verisi olmadan besleme atlanamaz.
resources.Translated: 没有现有参赛者数据，就无法跳过喂食。

resources.Key: The desired inherited ability is unavailable in current game data.
resources.Original: İstenen kalıtsal yetenek mevcut oyun verilerinde kullanılamıyor.
resources.Translated: 请求的遗传技能在现有游戏数据中不可用。

resources.Key: The native Select Chocobo list entry is unavailable or disabled.
resources.Original: Yerel Select Chocobo liste girdisi kullanılamıyor veya devre dışı.
resources.Translated: 本地选择 Chocobo 列表输入不可用或已禁用。

resources.Key: Scroll down to "The Dumpster Fire" channel to discuss issues / suggestions for specific plugins.
resources.Original: Belirli eklentilerle ilgili sorunları / önerileri tartışmak için "The Dumpster Fire" kanalına kaydırın.
resources.Translated: 要讨论与特定插件相关的问题/建议，请访问 “The Dumpster Fire” 频道。

resources.Key: Exact shopping list for the current plan.
resources.Translated: 现有计划的完整购物清单。

resources.Key: The observed Chocobo tab is not ready for its native button event.
resources.Original: Gözlenen Chocobo sekmesi kendi yerel düğme olayına hazır değil.
resources.Translated: 观察到的 Chocobo 选项卡尚未准备好应对其本地按钮事件。

resources.Key: Reserve stable and vendor automation seams.
resources.Original: Ahır ve satıcı otomasyonu için bağlantı noktalarını ayır.
resources.Translated: 分离谷仓和供应商自动化的端口。

resources.Key: Gold Saucer window did not appear in time.
resources.Translated: Gold Saucer 窗口未及时显示。

resources.Key: The observed retirement confirmation button is unavailable.
resources.Translated: 观察到的退休确认按钮不可用。

resources.Key: Pass {0}: buying missing feed ({1} sessions remain).
resources.Original: Tur {0}: eksik yem alınıyor ({1} seans kaldı).
resources.Translated: 回合 {0}:取回缺失的诱饵 ({1} 剩余会话)。

resources.Key: Initial racing tutorial admitted; VERMAXION owns the race.
resources.Original: İlk yarış eğitimi kabul edildi; yarışı VERMAXION yönetiyor.
resources.Translated: 首次比赛训练已获批准;比赛由 Vermaxion 主导。

resources.Key: The native gil-shop purchase could not be dispatched safely.
resources.Original: Yerel gil dükkânı satın alma isteği güvenle gönderilemedi.
resources.Translated: 当地商店的收购申请未能安全发送。
从 RaceChocoboManager 源安装，时间为{0:HH:mm:ss}。

resources.Key: Trainer feed inventory did not open after selecting the trainer menu entry.
resources.Original: Eğitmen menü girdisi seçildikten sonra eğitmenin yem envanteri açılmadı.
resources.Translated: 选择教练菜单输入后，教练的饲料清单并未打开。

resources.Key: Collection was requested; proof consumption and one matching fledgling must be reconciled before another request.
resources.Original: Teslim alma istendi; başka bir istekten önce belge tüketimi ve bir eşleşen yavru uzlaştırılmalı.
resources.Translated: 已申请提交;在提出其他申请之前，必须协调文件的使用和匹配的幼崽。

resources.Key: Load racing chocobo data first so the purchase plan can compare against sessions available.
resources.Original: Satın alma planının kullanılabilir seanslarla karşılaştırılabilmesi için önce yarış chocobosu verilerini yükleyin.
resources.Translated: 首先上传巧克力棒数据，以便将购买计划与可用会话进行比较。

resources.Key: Inventory window disappeared before the trainer-feed context menu became visible.
resources.Original: Eğitmen yemi bağlam menüsü görünmeden envanter penceresi kayboldu.
resources.Translated: 训练器上下文菜单出现之前，清单窗口就消失了。

resources.Key: The active G{0} {1} duplicates an owned usable parent and no productive pair is available.
resources.Original: Aktif G{0} {1}, sahip olunan kullanılabilir bir ebeveynle aynı ve üretken çift yok.
resources.Translated: 活跃 G{0}{1}与已拥有的可用父母相同，且没有生产性配对。

resources.Key: This log has reached Dalamud's 100 MiB limit. Logging may have stopped, so recent activity may be missing and this log may not help troubleshoot your current issue.
resources.Original: Bu günlük Dalamud’un 100 MiB sınırına ulaştı. Kayıt durmuş olabilir; son etkinlikler eksik olabilir ve günlük mevcut sorunu teşhis etmeye yardımcı olmayabilir.
resources.Translated: 该日志已达到 Dalamud 的 100 MiB 限制。记录可能已停止;最近的活动可能已丢失，并且可能无法帮助识别日志中存在的问题。

resources.Key: Breeding supply is purchased, but the supplier interaction did not release; Resume to reconcile the retained item.
resources.Original: Damızlık malzemesi alındı ancak tedarikçi etkileşimi bitmedi; tutulan öğeyi uzlaştırmak için Devam et seçin.
resources.Translated: 繁育材料已收到，但供应商的互动尚未结束;选择 “继续” 以协调保留的元素。

resources.Key: Plan exceeds sessions available: {0}/{1}. The shopping list below still reflects the full plan.
resources.Original: Plan kullanılabilir seansları aşıyor: {0}/{1}. Aşağıdaki alışveriş listesi yine de tüm planı yansıtır.
resources.Translated: 计划超出可用会话:{0}/{1}。下面的购物清单仍然反映了整个计划。

resources.Key: Collection requires the existing eligible covering, its retained-parent pedigree and exactly one Proof of Covering.
resources.Original: Teslim alma mevcut hazır çiftleştirmeyi, tutulan ebeveynin soy derecesini ve tam bir Proof of Covering gerektirir.
resources.Translated: 提交需要现有的现成配对、被提交亲本的血统等级以及完整的覆盖证明。

resources.Key: Could not open '{0}' on Tack & Feed Trader.
resources.Translated: Tack & Feed Trader 上的 “{0}” 无法打开。

resources.Key: Racing chocobo page detected; waiting for RaceChocoboManager data.
resources.Original: Yarış chocobosu sayfası algılandı; RaceChocoboManager verileri bekleniyor.
resources.Translated: 检测到比赛 Chocobo 页面;RaceChocoboManager 数据正在等待中。

resources.Key: Target pedigree G{0} is outside G2-G9.
resources.Original: Hedef soy derecesi G{0}, G2-G9 aralığının dışında.
resources.Translated: 目标血统等级 G{0},G2 至 G9 范围外。

resources.Key: Automation uses the session-capped plan and subtracts feed already on hand before buying.
resources.Original: Otomasyon seans sınırına uygun planı kullanır ve satın almadan önce eldeki yemi düşer.
resources.Translated: 自动化使用符合会话限制的计划，并在购买之前放弃手中的筹码。

resources.Key: Target cycle paused at a safe boundary.
resources.Original: Hedef döngüsü güvenli bir noktada duraklatıldı.
resources.Translated: 目标循环在安全点暂停。

resources.Key: No visible inventory window was found while opening the trainer-feed context menu.
resources.Original: Eğitmen yemi bağlam menüsü açılırken görünür envanter penceresi bulunamadı.
resources.Translated: 打开培训师诱饵上下文菜单时，未找到可见的清单窗口。

resources.Key: Covering wait has no valid eligibility evidence.
resources.Original: Çiftleştirme bekleyişinin geçerli hazır olma kanıtı yok.
resources.Translated: 没有证据表明配对等待已有效准备就绪。

resources.Key: Raise this non-matching G9 offspring as the missing owned counterpart; retain matching outputs.
resources.Original: Bu uygun olmayan G9 yavrusunu eksik sahip olunan eş olarak yetiştirin; uygun sonuçları tutun.
resources.Translated: 这个不合格的 G9 幼崽被培养成一个有缺陷的配偶;保持适当的结果。

resources.Key: Commence window did not appear after selecting Feed.
resources.Original: Feed seçildikten sonra Commence penceresi görünmedi.
resources.Translated: 选择源后，“开始” 窗口不会显示。

resources.Key: Discard is permanent. G9 stock, covering proof and selected breeding inputs are protected.
resources.Original: Atma işlemi kalıcıdır. G9 stoku, çiftleştirme kanıtı ve seçilmiş üretim malzemeleri korunur.
resources.Translated: 淘汰过程是永久性的。G9 库存、配对证明和选择的生产材料将被保留。

resources.Key: The active racer's sex is unavailable.
resources.Translated: 现役赛车手的性别无法使用。

resources.Key: Breeding, character or stock changed; cleanup stopped.
resources.Original: Üretim, karakter veya stok değişti; temizlik durduruldu.
resources.Translated: 生产、性能或库存发生了变化;清洁工作已停止。

resources.Key: Could not path near Tack & Feed Trader. Move closer or check vnavmesh.
resources.Original: Tack & Feed Trader yakınına rota bulunamadı. Yaklaşın veya vnavmesh'i kontrol edin.
resources.Translated: Tack & Feed Trader 附近未找到航线。请靠近或查看 vnavmesh。

resources.Key: Review the selected stock before discarding.
resources.Original: Atmadan önce seçili stoku gözden geçirin.
resources.Translated: 在放弃之前，请检查所选库存。

resources.Key: Start a new offspring batch only after the existing action, queue and covering have settled.
resources.Original: Yeni yavru grubunu ancak mevcut eylem, kuyruk ve çiftleştirme sonlandıktan sonra başlatın.
resources.Translated: 只有在现有活动、尾巴和交配结束后，才能开始新的幼崽群组。

resources.Key: Could not find Race Chocobo Trainer in Chocobo Square.
resources.Original: Chocobo Square içinde Race Chocobo Trainer bulunamadı.
resources.Translated: 巧克力广场未能找到赛车巧克力教练。

resources.Key: The retained covering parent changed before native selection.
resources.Original: Tutulan çiftleştirme ebeveyni yerel seçimden önce değişti.
resources.Translated: 保留的配对父母在本地选择之前就已更改。
符合条件的幼崽将被保留，不予登记。

resources.Key: The selected registration form changed before opening its context menu.
resources.Original: Seçilen kayıt formu bağlam menüsü açılmadan önce değişti.
resources.Translated: 所选记录形式在打开上下文菜单之前就已更改。

resources.Key: Current racer pedigree, racing rank, or sex is unavailable.
resources.Original: Kayıtlı yarışçının soy derecesi, yarış rütbesi veya cinsiyeti kullanılamıyor.
resources.Translated: 注册参赛者的血统等级、比赛级别或性别不可使用。

resources.Key: Retirement requires an intermediate rank40 racer and room for its retained form.
resources.Original: Emeklilik, rütbe 40 ara yarışçı ve tutulacak formu için yer gerektirir.
resources.Translated: 退役需要 40 级中级车手和保持赛车状态的空间。

resources.Key: Log ZIP ready. Share it manually; remove old exports when you no longer need them.
resources.Original: Günlük ZIP’i hazır. Elle paylaşın ve artık gerekmeyen eski dışa aktarımları silin.
resources.Translated: 日志 ZIP 准备就绪。手动共享并删除不再需要的旧导出内容。

resources.Key: Planned trainings exceed sessions available: {0}/{1}. Extra planned trainings will not fit this cycle.
resources.Original: Planlanan eğitimler kullanılabilir seansları aşıyor: {0}/{1}. Ek eğitimler bu döngüye sığmaz.
resources.Translated: 计划的培训超过了可用的课程:{0}/{1}。额外的培训无法进入这个循环。

resources.Key: Feed confirmation would cross the configured currency reserve.
resources.Original: Besleme onayı ayarlanan para rezervinin altına düşürecek.
resources.Translated: 进食确认将降低到设定的货币储备以下。

resources.Key: The verified required-supply shop closed before purchase.
resources.Original: Doğrulanan gerekli malzeme dükkânı satın almadan önce kapandı.
resources.Translated: 经验证的必需品商店在购买之前就已关闭。

resources.Key: A usable G{0} pair is already retained. Select owned parents or advance-pedigree permits before another covering.
resources.Original: Kullanılabilir G{0} çifti zaten tutuluyor. Başka çiftleştirme öncesinde sahip olunan ebeveynleri veya soy artırma izinlerini seçin.
resources.Translated: 可用的 G{0}对已被保留。选择在其他交配前已拥有的父母或繁衍许可。

resources.Key: Could not find Tack & Feed Trader in Chocobo Square.
resources.Original: Chocobo Square içinde Tack & Feed Trader bulunamadı.
resources.Translated: 在 Chocobo Square 内未能找到 Tack & Feed Trader。

resources.Key: Reload found an unverified feeding intent; it will not be replayed.
resources.Original: Yeniden yüklemede doğrulanmamış besleme niyeti bulundu; tekrarlanmayacak.
resources.Translated: 在重新装载过程中，发现了未经验证的喂食意图;这种情况不会再次发生。

resources.Key: Feed purchase completed without an exact item-ID quantity increase.
resources.Original: Yem alımı, tam öğe kimliğinin miktarında artış olmadan tamamlandı.
resources.Translated: 诱饵购买已完成，完整元素 ID 的数量没有增加。

resources.Key: Could not start Lifestream travel to Chocobo Square.
resources.Original: Chocobo Square konumuna Lifestream yolculuğu başlatılamadı.
resources.Translated: 未能启动前往 Chocobo Square 位置的 Lifestream 旅程。

resources.Key: Required-supply shop closed before the purchase result was verified.
resources.Original: Satın alma sonucu doğrulanmadan gerekli malzeme dükkânı kapandı.
resources.Translated: 在购买结果未经确认的情况下，所需材料店关闭了。
透明流和确定性流是优先考虑的。

resources.Key: Use the active racer's remaining training sessions before retirement.
resources.Original: Emeklilik öncesinde aktif yarışçının kalan eğitim seanslarını kullanın.
resources.Translated: 在退役前使用现役运动员剩余的培训课程。

resources.Key: Breeding must be settled and G9 reached.
resources.Original: Üretim işlemleri tamamlanmış ve G9'a ulaşılmış olmalıdır.
resources.Translated: 生产流程必须完成并达到 G9。

resources.Key: RaceChocoboManager did not load within 30 seconds after selecting the native Chocobo tab.
resources.Original: Yerel Chocobo sekmesi seçildikten sonraki 30 saniyede RaceChocoboManager yüklenmedi.
resources.Translated: 选择本地 Chocobo 选项卡后 30 秒，RaceChocoboManager 未被加载。

resources.Key: Retire the active G{0} {1} racer exactly.
resources.Original: Tam aktif G{0} {1} yarışçıyı emekliye ayırın.
resources.Translated: 完全活跃的 G {0} {1} 让赛车手退役。

resources.Key: Persisted feeding intent has no item baseline.
resources.Original: Kaydedilmiş besleme niyetinin başlangıç öğe verisi yok.
resources.Translated: 记录的喂养意图没有初始元素数据。
投掷操作的结果正在等待中......

resources.Key: Fall back to Grade 1, then skip

resources.Translated: 没有注册的赛马巧克力棒。

resources.Key: Status Content ID does not match the current character.
resources.Original: Durum Content ID değeri mevcut karakterle uyuşmuyor.
resources.Translated: 状态 Content ID 值与现有字符不匹配。

resources.Key: Reconcile the existing covering before producing another offspring.
resources.Original: Başka bir yavru üretmeden önce mevcut çiftleştirmeyi uzlaştırın.
resources.Translated: 在产下另一个后代之前，请协调现有的交配方式。

resources.Key: The initial racing tutorial awaits the next daily allowance.
resources.Original: İlk yarış eğitimi sonraki günlük hakkı bekliyor.
resources.Translated: 第一次比赛训练等待下一天的权利。

resources.Key: Plan training sessions, use feed already in inventory, and buy the remaining feed in one visit.
resources.Original: Eğitim seanslarını planlayın, envanterdeki yemi kullanın ve kalanını tek ziyarette satın alın.
resources.Translated: 安排培训课程，使用库存中的饲料，一次性购买剩余的饲料。

resources.Key: Breeding UI mappings still require native inspection before automatic selection is available.
resources.Original: Otomatik seçim kullanılabilmeden önce çiftleştirme arayüzü eşlemeleri yerel olarak incelenmeli.
resources.Translated: 在使用自动选择功能之前，必须在本地检查配对接口映射。

resources.Key: Counterpart covering requires permit mode and a reached pedigree of G2 or higher.
resources.Original: Eş üretmek için çiftleştirme izin modu ve elde edilmiş G2 veya üstü soy derecesi gerektirir.
resources.Translated: 要产生配偶，需要交配许可模式以及获得的 G2 或更高血统等级。
所需材料的采购已停止:{0}

resources.Key: Cover retained G{0} parents; preserve their remaining capacity.
resources.Original: Tutulan G{0} ebeveynleri çiftleştirin; kalan kapasitelerini koruyun.
resources.Translated: 将被保留的 G{0}父母配对;保留其剩余能力。

resources.Key: Choose your progression goal, reserves and feeding policy in VERMAXION settings, then Resume to begin.
resources.Original: VERMAXION ayarlarında ilerleme hedefinizi, rezervleri ve besleme politikasını seçin; başlamak için Devam et seçeneğini kullanın.
resources.Translated: 在 VERMAXION 设置中，选择进度目标、储备和进食策略;使用 “继续” 选项开始。

resources.Key: Persisted feed-purchase intent has no item baseline.
resources.Original: Kaydedilmiş yem alım niyetinin başlangıç öğe verisi yok.
resources.Translated: 记录的诱饵捕获意图没有起始元素数据。

resources.Key: Registrar race entry captured; initial training admission is awaiting verification.
resources.Original: Kayıt görevlisinin yarış girdisi yakalandı; ilk eğitim kabulü doğrulama bekliyor.
resources.Translated: 登记员的比赛记录已被捕获;首次培训接受等待确认。
许可目标：生育 G9 幼崽

resources.Key: Buy a G1 {0} registration form to raise a missing owned parent.
resources.Original: Eksik sahip olunan ebeveyni yetiştirmek için bir G1 {0} kayıt formu satın alın.
resources.Translated: 购买 G1 {0}注册表格，以培养缺乏照顾的父母。
注意力不集中时自动褪色
退休军衔{0},40-50 之间除外。

resources.Key: Another Choke-abo automation owns the feed/vendor services.
resources.Original: Besleme/satıcı hizmetlerini başka bir Choke-abo otomasyonu yönetiyor.
resources.Translated: 另一个 Choke-Above 自动化系统负责管理供应/供应商服务。

resources.Key: Feed purchase would cross the configured currency reserve.
resources.Original: Yem alımı ayarlanan para rezervinin altına düşürecek.
resources.Translated: 诱饵购买将降低到设定的货币储备以下。

resources.Key: This target cycle is owned by VERMAXION; use its Target Pedigree controls.
resources.Original: Bu hedef döngüsünü VERMAXION yönetiyor; oradaki Hedef soy derecesi kontrollerini kullanın.
resources.Translated: 此目标循环由 VERMAXION 管理;使用此处的目标血统等级控制。

resources.Key: The registered G{0} racer is below the retained G{1} pedigree; lower-generation racing is stopped.
resources.Original: Kayıtlı G{0} yarışçı tutulan G{1} soy derecesinden düşük; daha düşük nesil yarışları durduruldu.
resources.Translated: 注册 G{0}选手被保留的 G{1}血统等级较低;较低代际比赛已被停止。

resources.Key: Offspring production requires G9 breeding stock; lower-generation racing is stopped.
resources.Original: Yavru üretimi G9 damızlıkları gerektirir; daha düşük nesil yarışları durduruldu.
resources.Translated: 幼崽生产需要 G9 育种;较低的代际竞争已被禁止。

resources.Key: The feed batch is not fully present in inventory; reconcile its pending purchases before another vendor visit.
resources.Original: Yem grubunun tamamı envanterde yok; satıcıya tekrar gitmeden önce bekleyen alımları uzlaştırın.
resources.Translated: 整个诱饵组不在库存中;在再次前往供应商处之前，请协调待处理的购买事宜。

resources.Key: Cover the exact G{0} pair to produce the missing G{1} sex while the useful racer continues racing.
resources.Original: Yararlı yarışçı yarışırken eksik G{1} cinsiyetini üretmek için tam G{0} çiftini çiftleştirin.
resources.Translated: 在有用的竞争者比赛时，将完整的 G{0}对进行配对，以产生缺失的 G{1}性别。

resources.Key: Cover the retained G{0} parent and matching opposite-sex permit to produce G{1}.
resources.Original: G{1} üretmek için tutulan G{0} ebeveyni eşleşen karşı cins izinle çiftleştirin.
resources.Translated: 为生成 G{1}而保留的 G{0}父母与匹配的异性许可进行配对。

resources.Key: Use Refresh Chocobo Data or /chokeabo refresh to load racing chocobo stats.
resources.Original: Yarış chocobosu özelliklerini yüklemek için Chocobo verilerini yenile seçeneğini veya /chokeabo refresh komutunu kullanın.
resources.Translated: 使用 “刷新 Chocobo 数据” 选项或/chokeabo refresh 命令来安装比赛 Chocobo 功能。

resources.Key: An unowned Proof of Covering is present; its exact start time cannot be inferred safely.
resources.Original: Sahiplenilmemiş bir Proof of Covering var; kesin başlangıç zamanı güvenle çıkarılamaz.
resources.Translated: 存在未拥有的覆盖证明;无法可靠地确定最终开始时间。

resources.Key: Training confirmation window did not appear after Commence.
resources.Original: Commence sonrasında eğitim onay penceresi görünmedi.
resources.Translated: 开始后，没有出现训练确认窗口。
在主窗口中显示语言选择
注册赛车手数据不可用。

resources.Key: The required breeding supply was not found in the verified native shop.
resources.Original: Gereken damızlık malzemesi doğrulanmış yerel dükkânda bulunamadı.
resources.Translated: 所需的繁育材料在经过验证的当地商店中未能找到。

resources.Key: Breeding service interaction captured; its native selection must be verified before dispatch.
resources.Original: Çiftleştirme hizmeti etkileşimi yakalandı; gönderimden önce yerel seçimi doğrulanmalı.
resources.Translated: 配对服务交互被捕获;发货前需要验证本地选择。

resources.Key: Cover matching G9 stock with its retained opposite-sex G9 parent.
resources.Original: Uygun G9 damızlıklarını tutulan karşı cins G9 ebeveynle çiftleştirin.
resources.Translated: 将适当的 G9 后代与受保护的异性 G9 父母进行交配。

resources.Key: Refresh requested; opening Gold Saucer window...
resources.Original: Yenileme istendi; Gold Saucer penceresi açılıyor...
resources.Translated: 请求更新;Gold Saucer 窗口打开......

resources.Key: Cover the exact G{0} pair to advance toward G{1}.
resources.Original: G{1} yönünde ilerlemek için tam G{0} çiftini çiftleştirin.
resources.Translated: 将完整的 G{0}对配对以朝 G{1}方向移动。

resources.Key: No logged-in Content ID is available.
resources.Original: Giriş yapmış karakterin Content ID değeri kullanılamıyor.

Content ID 冲突：请求{0}，存在{1}。

resources.Key: Register the exact G{0} fledgling in {1} slot {2}.
resources.Original: Tam G{0} yavrusunu {1} içindeki {2} yuvasından kaydedin.
resources.Translated: 从{1}内的{2}槽中保存完整的 G{0}幼崽。

resources.Original: Yarış chocobosu özelliklerinin yenilenmesi iptal edildi.
resources.Translated: 比赛巧克力棒功能的更新已取消。

resources.Key: Feeding one {0}; awaiting exact item and session evidence.
resources.Original: Bir {0} veriliyor; tam öğe ve seans kanıtı bekleniyor.
resources.Translated: 给出{0};期待完整元素和会话证明。

resources.Key: Complete the registrar's initial racing training course.
resources.Original: Kayıt görevlisinin ilk yarış eğitimini tamamlayın.
resources.Translated: 完成登记员的首次比赛培训。

resources.Key: Track current stats and feed plans.
resources.Original: Mevcut özellikleri ve yem planlarını izle.
resources.Translated: 关注现有功能和诱饵计划。

resources.Key: Raise the matching G9 parent to retirement: racing rank {0}/40. Matching offspring stay unregistered.
resources.Original: Uygun G9 ebeveyni emekliliğe ulaştırın: yarış rütbesi {0}/40. Uygun yavrular kaydedilmez.
resources.Translated: 使符合 G9 标准的父母退休：竞争等级{0}/40。不登记符合条件的子女。

resources.Key: UI fonts failed to load. See the plugin log.
resources.Original: Arayüz yazı tipleri yüklenemedi. Eklenti günlüğüne bakın.
resources.Translated: 界面无法加载字体。请参阅插件日志。

resources.Key: No usable G{0} parent remains to produce a G{1} counterpart. Lower-generation covering is stopped.
resources.Original: G{1} eşi üretebilecek kullanılabilir G{0} ebeveyn kalmadı. Daha düşük nesil çiftleştirmeleri durduruldu.
resources.Translated: 已经没有可用的 G{0}父母能够产生 G{1}配偶了。低代交配已经被禁止。

resources.Key: Gold Saucer Info ready; waiting before Chocobo tab callback.
resources.Original: Gold Saucer Info hazır; Chocobo sekmesi geri çağrısından önce bekleniyor.
resources.Translated: Gold Saucer 信息已准备就绪;Chocobo 选项卡预计将在回拨前收到。

resources.Key: A Proof of Covering is present.
Native racing unlock verified; reassessing feeding and racing.
resources.Original: Yerel yarış erişimi doğrulandı; besleme ve yarışlar yeniden değerlendiriliyor.
resources.Translated: 当地比赛准入已确认;饲料和比赛正在重新评估。

resources.Original: Đã tạm dừng - cần chọn Tiếp tục
Không có hàng đủ điều kiện.
Đang chờ thức ăn trong túi đồ...
resources.Translated: 正在等待袋子里的食物......

resources.Key: XA Slave log tools could not be opened.
resources.Original: Không thể mở công cụ nhật ký XA Slave.
resources.Translated: 无法打开 XA Slave 日志工具。

resources.Key: Cover the exact G{0} pair to produce the missing G{1} sex.
resources.Original: Phối đúng cặp G{0} để tạo giới tính G{1} còn thiếu.
resources.Translated: 正确配对 G{0}以创建缺失的 G{1}性别。

resources.Key: The registered G9 racer does not have a confirmed requested trait. Retain it and select suitable breeding stock.
resources.Original: Chocobo đua G9 đã đăng ký chưa có đặc tính yêu cầu được xác nhận. Giữ nó và chọn đàn giống phù hợp.
resources.Translated: 巧克力蛙 G9 已注册，但需求特性尚未确认。保留它并选择合适的品种。

resources.Original: Đang xác minh chocobo đua đã đăng ký
resources.Translated: 正在核实已注册的巧可宝赛车

resources.Original: Lượt {0}: đang làm mới chỉ số chocobo. {1}
resources.Translated: 第{0}次：正在更新 chocobo 指数。{1}
适合 G9 的巧克力:{0:N0} / {1:N0}

resources.Key: Complete Like Sire Like Fledgling before retiring this racer.
resources.Original: Hoàn thành Like Sire Like Fledgling trước khi cho chocobo đua này nghỉ hưu.
resources.Translated: 在让这位巧克力赛车手退役之前，请完成《Like Sire Like Fledging》。

resources.Key: Stock cleanup is active; stop it before starting breeding.
resources.Original: Đang dọn kho; hãy dừng trước khi bắt đầu nhân giống.
resources.Translated: 正在清理仓库;在开始繁殖之前停止。

resources.Key: Paused by VERMAXION at a safe boundary.
resources.Original: VERMAXION đã tạm dừng tại điểm an toàn.
resources.Translated: 维马克西翁已在安全点暂停。
随时准备进行杂交配对

resources.Original: Đang đến gần Race Chocobo Trainer...
resources.Translated: 正在接近 Race Chocobo Trainer......

resources.Key: The Tack & Feed Trader is unavailable for interaction.
resources.Original: Tack & Feed Trader không khả dụng để tương tác.
resources.Translated: Tack & Feed Trader 无法进行互动。

resources.Original: Chu kỳ cho ăn thất bại.

resources.Key: Purchased feed could not be resolved to an exact inventory slot.
resources.Original: Không thể xác định ô túi đồ chính xác chứa thức ăn đã mua.
resources.Translated: 无法准确确定购买的食物在购物袋中的位置。

resources.Original: Trạng thái thực của túi đồ

resources.Key: Registration name stage {0} captured; final registration evidence remains pending.
resources.Original: Đã chụp giai đoạn đặt tên đăng ký {0}; bằng chứng đăng ký cuối cùng vẫn đang chờ.
resources.Translated: 已拍摄注册命名阶段{0};最终注册证明仍在等待中。

resources.Key: Offspring sex is random. Two coverings do not guarantee a male and a female.
resources.Original: Giới tính chocobo con là ngẫu nhiên. Hai lần phối giống không đảm bảo có một đực và một cái.
resources.Translated: 巧克力蛙幼崽的性别是随机的。两次交配并不能保证一雄一雌。

resources.Key: Buy the opposite-sex G{0} permit within reserves to produce G{1}.
resources.Original: Mua giấy phép G{0} khác giới trong giới hạn dự trữ để tạo G{1}.
resources.Translated: 在预留限额内购买其他 G{0}许可证以创建 G{1}。

resources.Key: The acceptable colours are unavailable in current game data.
resources.Original: Các màu chấp nhận được không có trong dữ liệu trò chơi hiện tại.
resources.Translated: 当前游戏数据中没有可接受的颜色。

resources.Key: The required covering fee would cross the gil reserve. Explicit Resume is required.
resources.Original: Phí phối giống bắt buộc sẽ làm gil thấp hơn mức dự trữ. Cần chủ động chọn Tiếp tục.
resources.Translated: 强制配种费将使基尔低于储备金。需要主动选择 “继续”。

resources.Key: Log into a character before starting breeding automation.
resources.Original: Đăng nhập nhân vật trước khi bắt đầu tự động phối giống.
resources.Translated: 在开始自动配种之前登录角色。

resources.Key: Missing an owned G{0} counterpart. No owned pair can produce G{1} or higher; select a permitted covering explicitly. Lower-generation rebuilding is stopped.
resources.Original: Thiếu cá thể đối ứng G{0} sở hữu. Không có cặp sở hữu nào có thể tạo G{1} trở lên; chủ động chọn phối giống được cấp phép. Đã dừng xây dựng lại từ đời thấp hơn.
resources.Translated: 缺乏 G{0}所有权对应的个体。没有所有权对可以创建 G{1}或更高;主动选择授权配对。已停止从较低生命周期重建。

resources.Key: Missing a usable opposite-sex G9 parent. Owned mode requires suitable G9 stock or an explicit switch to NPC permits.
resources.Original: Thiếu bố mẹ G9 khác giới khả dụng. Chế độ sở hữu cần đàn giống G9 phù hợp hoặc chủ động đổi sang giấy phép NPC.
resources.Translated: 缺乏 G9 异性父母。所有权模式需要符合 G9 条件的群体，或主动更改为 NPC 许可证。

resources.Key: Timed out moving near Race Chocobo Trainer.
resources.Original: Hết thời gian di chuyển đến gần Race Chocobo Trainer.
resources.Translated: 到达 Race Chocobo Trainer 附近的时间结束。

resources.Key: The current racer exceeds the selected target pedigree; retain it.
resources.Original: Chocobo đua hiện tại vượt đời giống mục tiêu đã chọn; giữ nó.
resources.Translated: 巧克力棒现在的比赛和你选择的目标一样，都是超越生命的;保持下去。

resources.Key: The selected covering stock is captured; native selected-parent evidence and the fee require verification before Commence.
resources.Original: Đã chụp đàn giống được chọn; xác minh bằng chứng bố mẹ đã chọn trên giao diện gốc và phí trước Commence.
resources.Translated: 已拍摄所选种群;在原始界面和开始前费用上验证所选父母的证据。

resources.Original: Mua thức ăn cho mục tiêu: {0}

resources.Key: The active G{0} racer is above target G{1}.
resources.Original: Chocobo đua G{0} đang hoạt động cao hơn mục tiêu G{1}.
resources.Translated: 巧克力蛙 G{0}正在超越目标 G{1}。

resources.Original: Vẫn xuất nhật ký đã đầy
resources.Translated: 仍在发布已填满的日志

resources.Key: Pause Content ID does not match the current character.
resources.Original: Content ID tạm dừng không khớp nhân vật hiện tại.
resources.Translated: 内容 ID 暂停与当前角色不符。

resources.Key: Pass {0}: waiting to verify caps in {1:0.0}s. {2}

resources.Original: Không thể tải dữ liệu chocobo đua hiện tại: {0}

resources.Original: Cho cá thể G{0} {1} hữu ích đua đến hạng {2}.
resources.Translated: 使个体 G{0}{1}有益于晋级到{2}级。

resources.Key: No usable retired G9 parent has a confirmed requested trait. Retain offspring and replenish suitable G9 stock.
resources.Original: Không có bố mẹ G9 nghỉ hưu khả dụng có đặc tính yêu cầu đã xác nhận. Giữ chocobo con và bổ sung đàn giống G9 phù hợp.
resources.Translated: 没有符合已确认要求特征的 G9 退休父母。保留 Chocobo 幼崽并添加适当的 G9 种群。

resources.Key: No breeding forms or covering proof in inventory.
resources.Original: Không có mẫu đăng ký giống hoặc giấy xác nhận phối giống trong túi đồ.
resources.Translated: 购物袋中未发现同种登记样本或同种配种确认书。

resources.Original: Đã xóa kế hoạch huấn luyện.

resources.Key: Cleanup complete: no planned training remains.
resources.Original: Dọn dẹp hoàn tất: không còn buổi huấn luyện dự kiến.
resources.Translated: 清理完毕：不再进行预定的训练。

resources.Key: Feed the target racer before declaring it ready.
resources.Original: Cho chocobo đua mục tiêu ăn trước khi báo sẵn sàng.
resources.Translated: 在通知准备就绪之前，先让巧可波赛跑目标吃东西。
轮到 {0}:正在喂食 (还有 {1} 会议)。

resources.Original: Đang di chuyển đến Chocobo Square...

resources.Key: Reload found an unverified feed-purchase intent; it will not be replayed.
resources.Original: Tải lại phát hiện ý định mua thức ăn chưa xác minh; sẽ không thực hiện lại.
resources.Translated: 重新下载发现购买食物的意图未经确认;不会再次执行。

resources.Key: Target inputs changed while an immediate feed action was awaiting evidence.
resources.Original: Đầu vào mục tiêu thay đổi khi thao tác cho ăn ngay đang chờ bằng chứng.
resources.Translated: 当正在等待证据的现场喂食操作时，目标输入会发生变化。

resources.Key: Covering is eligible; collection requires a verified native UI mapping.
resources.Original: Phối giống đã sẵn sàng; nhận con cần ánh xạ giao diện gốc đã xác minh.
resources.Translated: 配种已准备就绪;接收需要经过验证的原始接口映射。

resources.Original: Cho ăn theo các buổi đã lên kế hoạch
Đang đến gần Tack & Feed Trader...
resources.Translated: 正在接近 Tack & Feed Trader......

resources.Key: Covering Commence was dispatched; its exact confirmation or proof result must be reconciled before another covering.
resources.Original: Đã gửi Commence phối giống; đối chiếu xác nhận chính xác hoặc kết quả giấy xác nhận trước lần phối giống khác.
resources.Translated: 已发送开始杂交;核对确认正确或确认文件结果，之后再次进行杂交。

resources.Key: The covering confirmation would cross the gil reserve. Explicit Resume is required.
resources.Original: Xác nhận phối giống sẽ làm gil thấp hơn mức dự trữ. Cần chủ động chọn Tiếp tục.
resources.Translated: 确认杂交将导致基尔低于储备水平。需要主动选择继续。

resources.Key: Trainer feed flow stayed unstable after {0} recovery attempts. Last issue: {1}
resources.Original: Luồng cho ăn của người huấn luyện vẫn không ổn định sau {0} lần khôi phục. Vấn đề gần nhất: {1}
resources.Translated: 训练者的食物流在{0}次恢复后仍不稳定。最新问题:{1}

resources.Key: Buying {0} for {1} {2} within reserves; awaiting its inventory result.
resources.Original: Đang mua {0} với giá {1} {2} trong giới hạn dự trữ; chờ kết quả túi đồ.
resources.Translated: 正在以{1}{2}的价格购买{0}，在储备限额内;等待购物袋结果。

resources.Key: Could not reach the required breeding service for native UI inspection.
resources.Original: Không thể đến dịch vụ phối giống bắt buộc để kiểm tra giao diện gốc.
resources.Translated: 无法访问强制配种服务来检查原始界面。

resources.Key: Retirement confirmation sent; awaiting the retired form and cleared current racer. Any further native prompt is captured before another action.
resources.Original: Đã gửi xác nhận nghỉ hưu; chờ mẫu nghỉ hưu và xóa chocobo đua hiện tại. Mọi lời nhắc gốc tiếp theo được chụp trước thao tác khác.
resources.Translated: 已提交退休确认;等待退休模式并删除当前竞赛协议。任何后续原始提醒都将在其他操作之前拍摄。

resources.Key: Finish the existing covering with its saved goal before changing the production target.
resources.Original: Hoàn thành phối giống hiện tại với mục tiêu đã lưu trước khi đổi mục tiêu sản xuất.
resources.Translated: 在更改生产目标之前，完成当前配种与已保存目标的配对。

resources.Key: Cleanup did not start: load racing chocobo data first.

resources.Translated: 清理尚未开始：先下载 Chocobo 比赛数据。

resources.Original: Giấy phép phối giống với NPC
resources.Translated: 与 NPC 的配对许可

resources.Key: A required-supply purchase is unverified after reload; its matching pending confirmation or inventory result is required before another purchase.
resources.Original: Một lần mua vật tư bắt buộc chưa được xác minh sau khi tải lại; cần xác nhận đang chờ tương ứng hoặc kết quả túi đồ trước lần mua khác.
resources.Translated: 一次购买的必需品在重新下载后尚未确认;需要在下次购买前确认正在等待相应物品或购物袋结果。
